Close Issue-reference identity integration

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-26
  description: |-
    Issue UUID is the semantic identity. Tracker and MCP now prove one Issue resolves from key, uppercase prefix, lowercase prefix, and mixed prefix, while new results stay uppercase and stored identifiers stay the Workspace-key alias.
    
    Prefix freeze, alias isolation, concurrent collision, migration backfill, commit authority, and execution-name recovery are documented as one model: live resolution is semantic, sealed bytes and Git refs stay exact, and 0113_workspace_aliases rolls forward only.
